hints.title: Separate Parity Streams
hints.text: Collect elements at even indices into one list and elements at odd indices into another list.

hints.title: Sort with Opposing Polarities
hints.text: Sort the even index elements in non-decreasing order and the odd index elements in non-increasing order.

hints.title: Interleave Streams
hints.text: Interleave the sorted even and odd lists back into the original alternating pattern.
